author: Sirunyan, A.M. and others
title: Search for the decay of a Higgs boson in the ll gamma channel in proton-proton collisions at sqrt(s)=13 TeV
abstract: Search for H->Z gamma and H->gamma* gamma -> mu mu gamma using 35.9 fb-1 at 13 TeV. The observed (expected) combined 95% CL upper limit for mH=125 GeV is 3.9 (2.0) times the SM cross section. The H->Z gamma limit varies between 6.1 and 11.4.
